data.why: The repo ships paired CSV/JSON weight-matrix and fuzzy-membership examples for FCM design, aggregation and inference; no example dataset exists for the Learning page, so a small numeric dataset (with a missing value and an outlier) matching the bundled bacteria/city concept names was written for the preprocessing/learning workflow.

goals: Manually construct a numeric or linguistic Fuzzy Cognitive Map by defining concepts and causal weights, then run inference to see the system settle to an equilibrium state
Upload a predefined weight matrix (CSV) and run inference without having to build the map by hand
Aggregate linguistic causal knowledge from multiple experts (paired CSV + JSON fuzzy membership files) into a single defuzzified weight matrix and visualize the resulting graph
Upload a tabular dataset, clean/transform/normalize it, split it into input/output concepts, and train a Neural-FCM classifier or regressor on it
Visualize an FCM as a directed graph to inspect causal structure before or after learning

review.summary: The numeric design-and-simulate half is accurate, well-structured and backed by evidence, and its features are mostly well cut. But the tree leaves out FuzzyMind's other main purpose, learning FCM weights from data with Neural-FCM, and stops before the aggregation result (partly because of a pandas crash in this environment), so it needs a second pass before filing.
